marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Pop culture : a view from the papparazzi

"The wealthy and beautiful sisters Paris and Nicky Hilton have become celebrity icons. They are always wearing fashionable, stylish outfits, are often accompanied by a large entourage, and are photographes by the paparazzi in every imaginable situation almost every day of their lives. The Hilton sisters live like modern royalty, and have gained a reputation for extravagant shopping by day and wild partying by night. But Paris and Nicky are more than just a pair of pretty faces. These two young women are entrepreneurs, and each has created a successful career by using their brains and talents. Nicky has focused on a modeling career and on designing clothes and handbags, while Paris's success has come as a reality TV show actress and a pop singer. The Hilton sisters always seem to do the unexpected, and their many fans look forward to seeing what they will do next."
